assertions.description: Output uses git log or checks modification dates to determine when files were last updated
assertions.evidence: Table column 'Последнее обновление (git)' present for all 41 files with dates from 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-05.

assertions.description: Output identifies at least one specific file as potentially stale based on modification date or commit history
assertions.evidence: Section 'Критически устаревшие живые документы' identifies docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (v4.0), docs/MANUAL_TESTS.md (v4.3.0+), docs/USER_GUIDE_admin.md, docs/USER_GUIDE_owner.md, docs/USER_GUIDE_staff.md, MASTER_PLAN.md.

assertions.description: Output assigns AP-XX codes to freshness-related antipatterns (e.g. AP-XX for stale documentation)
assertions.evidence: No AP-XX codes anywhere in the output. Analysis is detailed and content-accurate but uses no AP-XX or AP-F0X coding system.

assertions.description: Output provides a Verification Score in N/5 format for documentation freshness
assertions.evidence: No N/5 score anywhere in the output. Output ends with recommendations table and narrative conclusion.
